name: AdGuard Home
description: Live query stats and one-tap protection toggle for your self-hosted AdGuard Home DNS ad blocker. Widgets show today's block percentage, top blocked domains, recent queries; tile-bound widgets let you toggle protection from any app. URL + Basic-auth credentials stay in encrypted device storage.
author: iappyx
aiPrompt: iappyx.plugin('adguard-home') talks to a self-hosted AdGuard Home DNS server (user configures URL + optional Basic-auth credentials via Settings → Plugins → AdGuard Home → Configure). All methods return Promises with an {ok, ...} or {ok:false, error} envelope. An unconfigured plugin returns {ok:false, error:'not configured'}. Surface: isConfigured() → {ok, configured}. ping() → {ok, version, runningAddresses[]}. getStatus() → {ok, running, protectionEnabled, version, dnsAddresses[], protectionDisabledDurationMs}. getStats() → {ok, numDnsQueries, numBlockedFiltering, numReplacedSafebrowsing, numReplacedParental, avgProcessingTime, percentBlocked, topQueried:[{name, count}], topBlocked:[{name, count}], topClients:[{ip, count}], dnsQueries:[number per hour, 24 entries newest-last], blockedFiltering:[same shape]}. setProtectionEnabled({enabled:true|false, durationMs:0}) → {ok, restoreAt:number|null} — durationMs:0 means indefinite, non-zero auto-restores after that many ms. getRecentQueries({limit:50, filter:'all'|'blocked'|'allowed'}) → {ok, entries:[{time, client, clientName, question, qtype, status, blocked, reason, rule, elapsedMs}], more, oldest}. Best widgets: 'block percent today + total queries' (Quick Widget candidate, refresh every 30s while visible), 'top 5 blocked domains today', 'protection toggle' (tap = toggle, long-press = pick duration 1/5/30/60 min), 'live query log scroller'. Rules: NEVER use fetch/XHR — always iappyx.plugin('adguard-home').*. Pause polling when not visible (iappyx.onVisibilityChange). Numbers use Intl.NumberFormat. Empty / unconfigured state should show 'Configure AdGuard in Settings → Plugins' rather than zeros.
